page.title: Account
page.subtitle: Your sign-in details, security and preferences.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.text: For your security, confirm your current details. This stays valid for 10 minutes.
reauth.textOtp: To continue, we send a code to <tech>{phone}</tech>.
reauth.smsDown: Text messages cannot be sent right now. Try again in a few minutes.

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.text: Enter your new number. We send a code to your current number and one to the new number, and you need both.
phone.smsDown: Text messages cannot be sent right now. Your number was not changed. Try again in a few minutes.
phone.codesText: Enter the code sent to your current number <tech>{old}</tech> and the code sent to the new number <tech>{new}</tech>.
phone.oldCode: Code sent to your current number
phone.newCode: Code sent to the new number
phone.expired: The codes have expired. Send new codes to continue.
phone.codeExpired: A code has expired. Typing it again will not help: send new codes to continue.
phone.codeLocked: A code is locked after too many wrong tries. Send new codes to continue.
phone.done: Your number was changed. Your other sessions and API tokens were ended.
phone.doneWithPasskeys: Your number was changed. Your other sessions and API tokens were ended. Check your passkeys in the Passkeys section.

password.label: Password
password.noneHint: Without a password you can only sign in with a text message code, which does not work when text messages are down.
password.done: Your password was changed. Your other sessions and API tokens were ended.
password.doneFirst: Your password was set. Your other sessions and API tokens were ended.

totp.label: Two-step verification
totp.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}
totp.lowCodes: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left. Make new ones now.} one {Only # recovery code left. Make new ones.} other {Only # recovery codes left. Make new ones.}}
totp.offHint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
totp.step1: Scan the code with your app
totp.restarted: The setup took too long, so we made a new code. Scan the new one.
totp.scanText: Open your authenticator app and scan this code. If you cannot scan it, type the key below into the app.
totp.copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
totp.copyNote: Closing this window empties the clipboard, whatever it holds by then, so something you copied from another app after the key is lost too. If the browser refuses at that moment, the clipboard is emptied when you come back to this tab. The clipboard history that Windows and some other systems keep is out of our reach: clear it yourself.
totp.savedRequired: Tick the box to confirm you saved the key.
totp.verifyText: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows now.
totp.ended: {count, plural, one {# other session was ended.} other {# other sessions were ended.}}
totp.codesWarning: These codes are shown only once. Each works one time if you lose your app. Keep them somewhere safe.
totp.fileHeader: Ctrl Z recovery codes. Each code works once. Keep this file somewhere safe.
totp.closeAsk: The codes are shown only once. Close without saving them?
totp.disableText: Signing in will no longer ask for a code from your app, and your recovery codes will stop working. Your other sessions will be ended.
totp.disabledEnded: {count, plural, one {Two-step verification is off. # other session was ended.} other {Two-step verification is off. # other sessions were ended.}}
totp.alreadyOnHint: If you did not see recovery codes, close this window and choose New recovery codes.
totp.enableLost: No answer came, so two-step verification may now be on with recovery codes you did not see. If the row behind this window says On, close this window and choose New recovery codes.
totp.regenerateLost: No answer came, so new codes may have been made and the old ones may no longer work. Try again to make new codes.

sessions.label: Sessions

method.otp: Signed in with a text message code

sessions.logoutAllText: Every session of your account ends, this one too. You will need to sign in again.

passkeys.reviewText: Your account was recovered recently. Look at this list and delete any passkey you do not recognise. Signing in with a passkey stays off until you confirm.
passkeys.liftText: Passkey enforcement ends on {date} unless the owner signs in with a passkey before then.
passkeys.staleText: This passkey belongs to an earlier address and cannot sign you in. Delete it and add it again.
passkeys.deleteText: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey.
passkeys.deleteEnforce: This is your last working passkey, so passkey enforcement turns off.
passkeys.addValue: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
passkeys.createText: Your device asks you to confirm with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
passkeys.ended: {count, plural, one {# other session was ended.} other {# other sessions were ended.}}
passkeys.duplicate: This device already has a passkey for your account.
passkeys.addFailed: The passkey could not be added. Try again.
passkeys.tooMany: You have reached the number of passkeys you can add. Delete one first.
passkeys.nameText: Give the passkey a name you will recognise.

enforce.label: Enforce passkey
enforce.description: Sign in with a passkey only. Passwords and text messages stop working for sign-in.
enforce.endedSessions: {count, plural, one {Passkey enforcement changed. # other session was ended.} other {Passkey enforcement changed. # other sessions were ended.}}
enforce.needs: To turn this on you need a working passkey, and another way to sign in as a fallback: a password or an authenticator app.
enforce.needsReview: Confirm your passkey list first. Enforcement cannot turn on while it needs a check.

home.label: Home countries
home.description: The countries you normally use the service from. Up to 3.
home.full: You can choose up to {max, number} countries. Remove one to choose another.
